text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system treats past purchases and listening or viewing interests as continuing demand for broadly related items, with insufficient attention to current purpose.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they extend a specific recent interest through a closely related artist, entertainment style, repair task, or compatible accessory.",
    "Useful additions to an existing setup resonate when they address a concrete need supported by interaction history."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related products compete with stronger matches despite requiring an unsupported project, device, entertainment preference, or use case.",
    "Past purchases are treated as renewed demand even when they may already satisfy the need, making redundant devices, supplies, and seasonal selections less timely.",
    "Related alternatives occupy multiple positions despite serving the same immediate need and offering little reason to choose more than one."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Broad category, brand, ecosystem, genre, or keyword similarity substitutes for a specific reason to choose an item.",
    "Historical affinity is carried forward without adequately distinguishing persistent interests from occasional or already satisfied needs."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent activity refines intent through a particular task, mood, musical style, or desired entertainment experience.",
    "Compatibility, exact specifications, quantity, and existing ownership determine whether an otherwise related product is useful now.",
    "A clear connection to familiar content or an established use matters more than a plausible but weak association; unidentified items provide insufficient evidence to infer preference or rejection."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Top-ranked items too often share a broad historical association while lacking the specific fit, timeliness, or additional usefulness needed to motivate a choice now.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations users would choose now, distinguished from items they consider merely related or potentially useful.",
    "The frequency of top-ranked rejections attributed to incompatible specifications, unsupported use cases, excessive quantities, or already satisfied needs.",
    "The frequency with which users prefer a lower-ranked item because it better matches their recent task, mood, or specific interest.",
    "The frequency of judgments that remain uncertain because item identity or available history cannot establish a meaningful match."
  ]
}
